tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// klong gsal rdo rje snying po las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs dang dbang chog klu chog gdon khrol bcas pa bdud rtsi'i zil thigs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru siṃ ha nā da ya/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyis// 'gro kun 'tsho mdzad 'phags pa mchog /spyi bor mchod nas gang de yi// sgrub thabs snying po rab gsal bya// 'di la gnyis/ rang don bdag bskyed bsnyen pa/ gzhan don sgrub mchod dbang la sogs pa'o// dang po la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: sgo gsum thugs rje chen por skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba drang phyir sgrub pa brtsam: lan gsum/ hrī: chos rnams gdod nas stong nyid 'od gsal ngang: snod bcud rnam dag rang byung gzhal yas dbus: siṃ las seng ge dkar mo'i gdan steng du: hrīḥyig dkar po'i 'phro 'du las byung ba'i: bdag nyid thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas gdan gnon tshul du kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la sbrul gyis rnam par dkris: g.yon pas pus mo'i thad du sbrul zhags 'dzin: dar ljang stod g.yogs dmar po'i sham thabs can: sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros: bde chen po ta la yi gnas mchog nas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gnyis med thim: rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan steng du: hrīḥyig dkar po tsheg drag bcas pa'i mthar: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer 'phros: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib pa sbyangs// byin rlabs tshur 'dus rang gi sgo gsum thim// sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad kun zhi nas// 'phags pa seng ge sgra dang dbyer med gyur// ces pa'i dmigs pa rtse gcig bsgom la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bzla/ bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'bum phrag dgu yin la/ rtags ni/ nyi zla shar dang shel phreng rnyed: dar phyar dung dkar 'bud pa sogs: ya mtshan ltas bzang dpag med 'byung: zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// thun mthar/

lhar snang gdod ma'i stong chen ngang du thim// slar yang ma bcos gnyug ma'i phyag rgyar shar// ces 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byas la/ shis brjod bsngo smon 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod do/ ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan don sgrub mchod dbang sogs la/ dkyil 'khor maṇ+ḍal me tog dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i khar/ bum pa nyer lnga'i rdzas ldan mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan bcas pa bkod/ dbang dang 'brel na shel phreng*/ sngags byang*/ shel rdo/ gtor ma dkar zlum rgyan ldan rnams bkod/ phyi mchod phreng tshar bsham/ klu chog dang gdon khrol la de dag gi skabs su 'byung ba'i bcas bsham bya'o// skyabs sems nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa yan grub pa dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hrī: snang srid dag pa chen po'i mchod pa'i sprin: gnyis 'dzin mtshan bral lha yi bdud rtsir gyur: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod rdzas byin brlab/ hrī: chos rnams gdod nas stong nyid sogs gong ltar la/ bdag nyid ces pa'i mal du/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po zhes sgyur la/ gnyis med thim: zhes pa'i bar gyis dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drang bstim mchod bstod dang bcas pa ni/ hrī: 'og min bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' 'gro don mkhyen brtse'i lha: thugs rje chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa rā sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hrī: dad pa'i pho brang ting 'dzin rten mchog la: mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bcom ldan bzhugs gsol 'tshal: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi na: bcom ldan dgyes pa'i zhal bzang bdag la ston: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: hrī: rgyal ba rnams ni 'dod pa'i skyon bral yang: bdag sogs tshogs gnyis bsod nams bskul slad du: rnam par sprul pa'i phyi nang mchod tshogs kyis: 'phags mchog dgyes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: hrī: mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: de la der snang sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdun bskyed thugs kar zla ba'i gdan steng du: hrīḥyig dkar po tsheg drag sogs bzlas dmigs gsal btab la bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla/ gzungs thag blangs la/ bum nang 'phags thugs hrīḥl sngags phreng bskor: bdag srog 'od kyis rgyud bskul don gnyis bsgrubs: khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan sdug bsngal sbyangs: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang: zhes bsgoms la sngags ci 'grub bzla/ mthar mchod bstod bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas bum lha bdud rtsir zhu bar mos/ dbang dang klu chog gdon bkrol sogs gang byed kyang skabs 'dir bya/ mthar mchod bstod dang nongs bshags yig brgya brjod/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa gshegs bstim gang 'os dang bdag bskyed bsdu ldang gong smros ltar byas la/ bkra shis ni/ hrī: thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i lha: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa phrin las kyis: ye shes stong nyid snying rje nus pa'i char: khams gsum sems can kun la bde legs stsol: bsngo ba ni: 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' mnyam sems can yongs la khyab par bsngo: smon lam ni: bdag gis sems bskyed smon lam khyab byed 'gro: myur du kun mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog: ces pas grub bo/ ༈ /dbang bskur na/ bum lha 'od zhu grub pa dang las bum 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis byin brlabs pas slob ma la khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang la mtshams gcad/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi snying rje chen po gzugs su snang ba 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de nyid kyis/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang 'gro ba drug gi gnas mtha' dang mu med pa rnams su gang la gang 'dul gyi mtshan dang sku'i bkod pa tshad dang dpag gis mi lang par bstan pa rnams las/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa zhi ba la khyad par du bsngags pa klu'i 'phags pa bdud rtsi sman gyi sku can 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus mang po 'phags bod kyi ljongs su byon pa las/ skabs 'dir gu ru rin po che pad+ma sam+bha wa'i zhal lung*/ rnying ma gter ma'i phyogs las lang gro'i rnam 'phrul gter chen mdo sngags gling pas spyan drangs pa'i klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i yan lag gi chos sde 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i dbang bskur bgyid pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma bla ma thugs rje can: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yi: dbang mchog dam pa bskur du gsol: smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas snod du rung bar gyur pa la gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ ho: dad dam skal pa ldan yin na: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po ni: seng ge sgra yi dbang sbyin nas: smin cing grol bar bdag bgyid do: rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed 'phags pa seng ge sgra rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i 'khor tshogs bcas sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi zhing*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: sgo gsum thugs rje chen por skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba drang phyir sgrub pa brtsam: lan gsum/ tshogs zhing de dag gi spyan sngar bdun rnam dag sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems gzung ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/

dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ dbang gi gzhi dgod pa la ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzad 'tshal/ hrī: chos rnams gdod nas sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ khyed rang thugs rje chen po zhes sgyur la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim par mos shig / ces dang snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa brjod la spos rol bcas byin dbab/ ye shes pa brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐: rdo rje me tog mgor bzhag / bum pa'i gzhal yas khang du 'phags mchog seng ge sgra dngos su gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bkrus/ khyed rang ye shes kyi sku dngos su gyur par mos shig /hrī: bum pa lha yi gzhal yas na: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu sbyin/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku'i dbang thob/ 'phags pa'i sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// hrī: bdag nyid thugs rje chen po yi: thugs kar hrīḥyig mtha' ma ru: sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i zer: zhal nas brgyud de khyod la thim: slob ma'i thugs kar sngags phreng bskor: gsung gi dbang mchog thob par gyur: de ltar sgoms la snying po'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ shel phreng gtad la snying po lan gsum rjes zlos/ de brtan par byas par mos shig / phreng ba sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la/ hrī: snang stong ma 'gags thugs rje chen po yi: grags stong ma 'gags sngags kyi phreng ba'i rgyun: slob ma byin gyis brlab phyir 'phro ba 'di: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la brtan par mdzod: rtsa sngags/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: ye dharmā sogs brjod/ des ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi dbang thob/ gsung gsang sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas pa yin no// 'phags mchog seng ge sgra'i thugs ka nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'od lnga'i gong bu tshon gang ba thugs kar thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs 'phos par mos la rig stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bor mnyam par zhog cig

/hrī: phyi gsal nang gsal dri med shel ltar gsal: gsal cha 'gag med yi dam lha yi thugs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la 'di thim pas: thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang gnyis su med: rtsa sngags mthar/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes shel rdo snying gar gtugs/ des yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dbang thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// gtor ma 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i rten dang brten par bcas pa dngos su gsal ba khyed rang gi spyi bor byon/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rgyun babs/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang dbye ba med par byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /hrī: dam rdzas gtor chen lha yi gzhal yas na: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs: skal ldan bu mchog khyod la dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lhun grub shog: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hrī: zhes gtor ma gnas lngar bzhag / des sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag /yongs rdzogs chen po'i dbang bskur thob/ 'phags mchog 'di nyid la bsten pa'i don gnyis bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// shis pa brjod/ 'di nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis: lha bsgom sngags bzlas don brtson zhing: rtag tu 'gro ba'i don la spyod: phrin las ma dor sa ma ya: ji skad bsgos pa'i dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sogs rjes chog rnams kyang gong du smros pa ltar ro// yongs grags gsal byed don chung yang*// dman la phan phyir 'di bris dges// byin rlabs zla 'od bdud rtsi 'jo// phan bde'i chu gter gong 'phel shog /ces pa'ang rin chen gter gyi mdzod dgos rgu 'dzad pa med pa'i cha rkyen du pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis legs par bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/

sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: 'phags mchog seng ge sgra'i dkyil 'khor du srung ma klu'i sgrub pa bzhugs so: 1$0000300 srung ma klu'i cho ga la thog mar bum rdzas ni: bzang po drug: tsan+dan gnyis: ut+pal: gser gyi me tog: pri yang ku: snyi ba'i me tog: zho sha'i rigs: mtshal: ge sar gsum: mngar gsum: rgya mtsho lbu ba: ga pur: dbang lag rnams so: thog mar dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i phyi rol sbrul dkar ser dmar ljang gnyis gnyis te mtshams bzhir mjug ma mdud pa khor yug rgya mtshos bskor ba'i dbus su mañji'i khar bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bshams la: rdzas rnams blugs: 'dab brgyad la klu chen brgyad: sbal sbrul lcong mo kha brgyad sogs kyi gzugs: gla ba bya khyung phag ma gtogs pa bsham: srung ma klu'i cho ga la 'jug pa ni: mdun du mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du gzhal yas khang chen po mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa: mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i dbus su: chu bdag wa ru ṇa: de bzhin mtha' yas: 'jog po: stobs rgyu: dung skyong: rigs ldan: pad+ma: pad+ma chen po la sogs klu dang sa bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsgoms la rang rang gi gnas nas spyan drangs: gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od zer gyis: klu yi mun pa sel mdzad cing: bstan la dga' ba'i klu rgyal kun: ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po dang: gsher dang 'byung bar rten bcas pa'i: dad dang 'byor ldan klu yi tshogs: 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren no: pad+ma dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs: sman dang dar zab 'bru yi tshogs: klu rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes byed cing: klu yi nad kun zhi ba'i sman: chos dang gang 'dod char pa bzhin: klu la 'bad med lhun grub 'bul: thugs kar yi ge phuḥyi mtha' skor du: sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms la sngags 'di bzla: oṃ phuḥwa ru ṇa ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ phuḥ.a nan+ta nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥbā su kī ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥtak+ṣa kā ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥkarko ta ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥpad+ma ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥm hā pad+ma ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥshaṃ kha pā la ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phuḥku li kā ye nā ga rā tsa phu hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa: ar+ghaṃ sogs shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: e ma dad dang 'byor ldan klu yi tshogs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgyes pa bskang phyir 'dod yon 'bul: nad sel sman gyi rigs rnams 'bul: klu rgyal 'dod pa tshims gyur cig: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: 'jig rten khams 'dir char 'beb cing: 'bru dang mi nor 'phel bar mdzod: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: 'dod yon 'byor pa 'phel ba dang: che btsun bzang dgu dbang sdus shig: grags pa'i dpal 'byor thob pa dang: snyan pas 'jig rten khyab par mdzod: 'jig rten khams kyi skye 'gro yi: lus sems klu yi mthus bskyed pas: gzhan sems rang dbang med par choms: mchod cing sgrub pa'i 'dod don stsol: phrin las myur du ma bsgrub na: ye shes lha yi thugs dang 'gal: klu rgyal dam tshig nyams la re: de bas gang bcol phrin las rnams: myur du sgrubs shig sa ma ya:

de ltar sgrub pa tshar nas klu sman 'dod yon dang bcas pa khang pa'i grwa bzhir bum gter sba bar bya'o: sa ma ya: ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: ces grogs po pad+ma mkha' spyod kyis bskul ba la brten nas bdag nyid klong gsal snying pos dag par phab pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje snying po las: 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i las tshogs gdon bkrol gyi lhan thabs bltas chog bzhugs: 1$0000300 'dir gdul bya la klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa shin tu thu bar gyur na: thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i bsnyen pa thon pa'i rnal 'byor pas: spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i sgo nas gdon khrus byed par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis: gnas gtsang mar byas nas ba yi chag chag byas la: dbus su thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i dkyil 'khor bum pa dang bcas pa bsham: logs shig tu klu mchod thog rtsi sman gyi bum pa bsham: logs shig tu sa bdag gi dkyil 'khor ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i thog tu glang chen: mtha' skor du gla ba bya khyung phag ma gtogs gzugs 'gros kyis bskor: phyi rol du sbal pa sdom sdig pa kha brgyad rnams bzhag: shing rtsis mi mngon par bya: thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa la 'bad: de nas tho rangs bya byis kyi skad ma grags pa'i gong nas nad pa la khrus bya ba ni: ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni: nus ldan bdud rtsi'i chu 'di ni: spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i chus: skal ldan khyod la khrus gsol bas: nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya: oṃ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya: bo dhi satwā ya: ma hā satwā ya: ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ a ka ṭi: bi ka ṭi: ni ka ṭi: ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi: ka ro ṭi bhir ya swā hā: gdengs ka'i phyag gis: oṃ nā ga nan: nā ga ni nan: nā ga ku mā ra nan: nā ga ku mā ra ni nan: a gats+tsha ya: a gats+tsha ya: lan gnyis/
